name: Glissade
body:
School transmutation; Level druid 1, magus 1, ranger 1, sorcerer/wizard 1, summoner 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S, M/DF (a fragment of an ice skate or ski)

EFFECT

Range touch

Target creature touched

Duration 1 min./level (D)

Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes

The subject gains a +10 enhancement bonus on Acrobatics checks made when moving across snow-covered or icy terrain. The enhancement bonus increases to +20 at 5th caster level, and to +30 (the maximum) at 9th caster level.
